name: Royal1155LDA amount-blind batch bookkeeping inflating a royalties claim 100x
summary: Royal1155LDA._beforeTokenTransfer loops over the ERC-1155 ids array and never reads the parallel amounts array, so it credits the recipient's shadow per-tier balance _BALANCES_[tierId][to] with exactly one unit per array entry regardless of how many units the ERC-1155 transfer actually moves. Its sender-side branch is additionally skipped whenever _IS_OWNED_TOKENS_BACKFILL_COMPLETE_ is false and the sender's shadow balance has already reached zero, so the same id can be listed many times without reverting. A safeBatchTransferFrom listing LDA id 42<<128|424242 one hundred times with one hundred zero amounts therefore left tierBalanceOf(42, receiver) at 100 against a tier supply of 1, and Royalties, which pro-rates a tier's deposited USDC by tierBalanceOf, paid a claim 100 times the attacker's own 2638.089539 USDC royalty deposit and emptied the contract.
notes: An eth_getLogs scan of the Upgraded topic on the TransparentUpgradeableProxy from genesis to the exploit block returns exactly twelve events; the last, at 41219477:52 logIndex 311, selects Royal1155LDA 0xd5b297c08d890376b6cbdba6023a39ffbdf65c78, which is still in the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot at block 89018050.

The Royalties proxy 0xfe16ee78828672e86cf8e42d8a5119ab79877ec7 held 261170.864398 USDC of undistributed royalties at block 89018050 and 0.000037 USDC at block 89018051, so 261170.864361 USDC of other holders' funds left it. The 2638.089539 USDC the attacker deposited into the same tier in the same transaction was flash-borrowed from the QuickSwap USDC/WMATIC pair 0x6e7a5fafcec6bb1e78bae2a1f0b612012bf14827 and is an attacker-supplied input, so it is not counted; the 7.938083 USDC flash-loan fee likewise does not reduce gross depletion. The attacker's own net take was 263808.9539 minus 2646.027622 = 261162.926278 USDC, which is the figure the seed row carried as 261163.
